title: Curio Node Package Manifest (v4)
description: Schema for a Curio node-package manifest.json. A package ships in a directory named '<packageId>@<major>' containing this manifest, an optional README.md / LICENSE, an optional sources/ directory with one starter file per kind, and (after install) an integrity.json with SHA-256 hashes of every shipped file. The pre-installed 'curio.builtin' package ships with the app and provides the default 14 node kinds; third-party packages install via the catalog drawer or by importing a `.curio.zip` archive. A package of kind 'model' also ships its weights under models/ and says how to run them in 'model'.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Conventionally the raw GitHub URL of the schema file.

version.description: Semver-style version. Pre-release / build metadata accepted.

name.description: Human-readable package name shown in the catalog drawer.

publisher.description: Human-readable publisher name shown alongside the package.

description.description: Short description shown in catalog cards.

license.description: SPDX-style license identifier (e.g. 'MIT'); null for unspecified. For a model package, the license of its code; 'model.license' is the weights'.

kind.description: 'node' for a package of nodes, or 'model' for a package that also ships a model's weights under models/, described by 'model'. Model packages show in the Model Catalog.

readOnly.description: When true, this package cannot be overwritten via factory-install / Save-As. The package is omitted from the Save-As destination dropdown. Used by the built-in package and by curated organisation packages.

behaviorScript.description: Path, relative to the package root, of a pre-built JS bundle that registers this package's custom behavior hooks at boot (e.g. 'scripts/behaviors.js'). Required for any package whose templates declare a custom behavior key rather than a built-in one; omit it for pure-Python (code-editor) packages.

major.description: Major version of the package. The package's on-disk directory is '<id>@<major>'.

curioRuntime.description: Required Curio runtime range (informational; not enforced at install time yet).

permissions.description: Declared capability strings (e.g. 'filesystem.read'). Informational; not yet enforced.

dependencies.description: Other packages / Python / JS dependencies this package needs at install time.

packages.description: { '<packageId>' or '<packageId>@<major>': '<version-range>' }, resolved via /api/packages/resolve. A node of this package can import the Python modules these packages ship in sources/.

lineage.description: Fork provenance. Present when this package was forked from another via the Node Factory.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 instant when the manifest was authored. Used as the canonical sort key in the catalog (newest first).

templates.description: Node templates this package defines. Each entry becomes a draggable node in the canvas palette.

backend.description: Optional server-side surface (memo dev/91): one Python entry file under backend/ exposing 'def handle(payload)', plus the declared handler names the package backend sandbox will accept. Requires the 'server-code' permission ('server-network' additionally when handlers use the network). Executed only in per-invocation sandboxed workers — never imported by the Curio host process.

entry.description: Package-relative path of the handler entry file, e.g. 'backend/handler.py'.

name.description: Handler name — the sandbox routes POST /api/packages/<dir>/backend/<name> to it.

timeoutClass.description: Worker-limit tier (the build workspace's LIMITS_BY_TIMEOUT_CLASS). Default: standard.

model.description: How to run the weights a model package ships: what curio_load_model("<packageId>") reads.

type.description: 'semantic-segmentation': one label per pixel. 'image-to-image': images in, an image out. 'node-regression': a graph in (node features and edges), values for each node out. The node that runs an image-to-image or node-regression model feeds it itself (model.run).

runtime.description: 'onnx': one .onnx file, with any external data beside it. 'transformers': a checkpoint folder from_pretrained reads.

entry.description: The .onnx file, or the checkpoint folder, under models/.

labels.description: The class of each output channel. An onnx segmentation model names them; a Transformers checkpoint may leave them to its config.json.

sizeBytes.description: The size of the weights in bytes.

discoverySource.description: Where a model downloaded from the Discovery Catalog came from.

licenseFile.description: Package-relative path of the weights' license text.

modelInput.description: An ONNX image model's input: width x height in NCHW (or NHWC, for an image-to-image model), as uint8 pixels or as float32 scaled by 'scale' and then normalized by 'mean' and 'std'.

widget.description: One widget of a node (#662), in the shape of a dataflow node's metadata.widgets entries (docs/schemas/trill.v1.json).

name.description: Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Not input_0, input_1 and so on: those names read the node's inputs.

id.description: Kebab-case template id. Canonical type at runtime is '<packageId>/<templateId>' (unversioned) or '<packageId>/<templateId>@<major>' (versioned).

label.description: Display name in the palette / canvas.

engine.description: Execution engine for the source code.

behavior.description: Key into the frontend behaviorRegistry (e.g. 'code', 'vega', 'data-pool'). See packages/curio.builtin@1/manifest.json for the canonical set.

iconRef.description: FontAwesome ref like 'fa-solid:upload' or 'fa-brands:python'. Resolved by the frontend iconRegistry.

paletteOrder.description: Sort key in the palette (lower = earlier). Omit to use the default 1000+offset (third-party packages sort after built-ins).

editor.description: Editor surface shown when the node is opened.

badge.description: Palette card badge label (e.g. 'VEGA', 'AUTK'). Omit for plain cards; third-party packages default to 'PACKAGE'.

source.description: Package-relative path to a single optional starter source file (e.g. 'sources/uhvi-load.py', 'sources/chart.vl.json'). Omit for structural kinds (built-in nodes ship no starter).

bidirectional.description: When true, the descriptor adds a third handle (`id: 'in/out'`, `position: top`) on top of the standard in/out pair so data can flow back through the node (used by visualization + pool kinds for interaction loops).

containerStyle.description: Overrides for the canvas node container's static layout. Most kinds use defaults; a kind with noContent renders as a chip of exactly this size, such as a narrow vertical rail.

hasProvenance.description: Whether the node exposes a provenance tab in its editor. Defaults to true; set to false to suppress (e.g. on display-only kinds).

backendHandler.description: Name of a declared backend handler this template's Run invokes through the package backend sandbox (memo dev/91). Must appear in the package's backend.handlers.

widgets.description: The widgets a freshly dropped node of this template starts with (#662). The template's source places each one as a `[!! name !!]` reference.
